topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I can scarce believe the gall of them! Left their junk forgotten, tucked away like rats in the attic. Now, 'tis me who's got to dredge through their folly and clear it all out, else the house will start to rot from the inside, what with the damp and the neglect. And for what? They had no need nor care for these things, or they would've taken them on their leaving. I've a mind to just let it be, let it all molder, but that's not the way of a good man. So I'll toil and sweat to clear their disregard, and all the while I'll wonder at the strange ways of those who leave behind not just a home, but a burden.
